title: Sine, cosine & tangent
sentences: Opposite and adjacent depend on the angle you choose; the hypotenuse does not.
Sine connects opposite and hypotenuse, cosine connects adjacent and hypotenuse, and tangent connects opposite and adjacent.
Use a calculator in degree mode when the angle is given in degrees.
A right triangle has a 30° angle and a 10 cm hypotenuse.
Opposite and hypotenuse belong to sine: sin 30° = opposite / 10.
sin 30° = 0.5, so the opposite side is 5 cm.
